shortDescription: Haryana HTET 2025 Result, Final Answer Key and OMR Sheet updates are available for Level 1, 2 and 3. Check the official BSEH/HTET portal.
content:
Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has released updates for the Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test (HTET) 2025, including the result, final answer key, scorecard/certificate and OMR sheet for Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3.

Important Dates

  • Application: 24 December 2025 to 05 January 2026
  • Correction: 04–05 January 2026
  • Exam: 04–05 July 2026
  • Admit card: 01 July 2026
  • Answer key: 06 July 2026
  • Final answer key and result: 05 August 2026
  • OMR sheet: 01 September 2026

Level-wise eligibility

  • Level 1 PRT: 10+2 with the required marks and a recognised elementary education or special education qualification, subject to the official alternatives.
  • Level 2 TGT: Bachelor degree with D.El.Ed., B.Ed., Special B.Ed. or the listed four-year integrated qualification.
  • Level 3 PGT: Concerned subject Master degree with B.Ed. as prescribed.

Use the official HTET portal to check marks, qualifying status, final answer key, OMR sheet and scorecard/certificate. The eligibility test is not itself a job appointment; recruitment conditions are decided in the relevant Haryana teacher advertisement.
